# Mette Hedelund

Mette Hedelund is a quality consultant (kvalitetskonsulent) at [[sundhedsvaesenets-kvalitetsinstitut|Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut]], the Danish institute responsible for healthcare quality databases, and she serves as the designated contact person for the ADHD-databasen [^src1][^src2]. Her role places her at the administrative center of the ADHD Database's 2024 annual report, an assessment of ADHD diagnosis and treatment quality across Denmark's child, youth, and adult populations, published by Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut and led by Shelagh Powell and Simon Hjerrild. That report marked the first time the database included data from the adult population and private hospitals, alongside documenting ongoing challenges in registration practices, staffing resources, and long waiting times in child and adolescent psychiatry.

Hedelund is listed on the report's contact page with her direct phone number, (+45) 51258301, and email address, metheu@sundk.dk [^src1]. In the report's later pages, covering the steering group and appendices on the database population for the period 1 April 2024 to 31 March 2025, she is again identified in her capacity as "Kontaktperson og repræsentant for dataansvarlig myndighed" — contact person and representative of the data-responsible authority [^src2]. This dual identification underscores her function as the formal liaison between the institute and the database's steering group, which represents Denmark's five regions, professional societies, and patient organizations.
